name: Small weight 4-vertex quivers labeled by mutation-acyclicity
description: Dataset of 4-vertex quivers mutation equivalent to quivers with maximum edge multiplicity 2, including mutation-class properties (acyclicity, finiteness, surface/vortex equivalence, etc.) and invariants (Alexander polynomial, exchange-matrix determinant, gcd vector, rank, class index). Several integer-valued fields (e.g. determinant of exchange matrix, Alexander polynomial coefficients, class index) can exceed 2^64 in magnitude, so all numeric fields are typed as sc:Text to preserve arbitrary-precision values.

recordSet.name: quivers
recordSet.description: Each record describes one 4-vertex quiver and the properties of its mutation class.

field.name: quiver exchange matrix
field.description: Flattened 4x4 skew-symmetric exchange matrix B in row-major order. Source value is bracketed and space-separated, e.g. '[0 -2 -2 -2 2 0 -2 -2 2 2 0 -2 2 2 2 0]'.

field.name: mutation acyclic
field.description: Whether the mutation class contains an acyclic representative. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: mutation abundant
field.description: Whether all quivers in the the mutation class are abundant. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: mutation complete
field.description: Whether all quivers in the the mutation class are complete. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: mutation connected
field.description: Whether all quivers in the the mutation class are connected. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: mutation equivalent to a quiver with a mutation-cyclic 3-vertex subquiver
field.description: Whether the mutation class contains a quiver with a mutation-cyclic 3-vertex subquiver. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown

extract.column: mutation equivalent to a quiver with a mutation-cyclic 3-vertex subquiver

field.name: mutation finite
field.description: Whether the mutation class is finite. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: finite forkless part
field.description: Whether the forkless part of the mutation class is finite. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: finite preforkless part
field.description: Whether the preforkless part of the mutation class is finite. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: surface quiver
field.description: Whether the quiver arises from a triangulated surface. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: mutation equivalent to a quiver with a vortex subquiver
field.description: Whether the mutation class contains a quiver with a vortex subquiver. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

extract.column: mutation equivalent to a quiver with a vortex subquiver

field.name: totally proper
field.description: Whether every quiver in the mutation class is proper. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: Alexander polynomial
field.description: Coefficient list of the Alexander polynomial associated with the mutation class. Source value is bracketed and space-separated, e.g. '[1 68 -122 68 1]'.

field.name: number of vertices
field.description: Number of vertices of the quiver.

field.name: determinant of exchange matrix
field.description: Determinant of the exchange matrix.

field.name: gcd vector
field.description: Per-row gcd vector of the exchange matrix. Source value is bracketed and space-separated, e.g. '[2 2 2 2]'.

field.name: rank of exchange matrix
field.description: Rank of the exchange matrix over the integers.

field.name: determinant of companion modulo 4
field.description: Determinant of the companion matrix taken modulo 4.

field.name: mutation cycle in class
field.description: Whether the mutation class contains a non-trivial mutation cycle. Tri-valued enum encoded as text matching the regex ^(T|F|NULL)$ where T=true, F=false, NULL=unknown.

field.name: minimum number of arrows in class
field.description: Minimum total number of arrows over all (observed) quivers in the mutation class. Not guaranteed to be minimal/invariant.

extract.column: minimum number of arrows in class
